text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of more than the recommended dose of SUFLAVE may lead to severe electrolyte disturbances, as well as dehydration and hypovolemia, with signs and symptoms of these disturbances [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 , 5.2 , 5.3 )] . Monitor for fluid and electrolyte disturbances and treat symptomatically.
